title: RetryRoute: Retry-Aware Model Routing for Agentic Image Editing Services
abstract: arXiv:2610.41460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents increasingly edit images by calling open editing models in a critique-and-retry loop, and these models differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. After every rejected edit, a service must decide whether to retry the same model, escalate to another or give up. Existing routers pick one model per request, and cascades escalate in a fixed order. However, both treat a retry as an independent draw. We identify sticky failures, meaning that a retry after a failure succeeds only 17-53% as often as a first try across six open models, three benchmarks and two judges. Based on this finding, we propose RetryRoute, a retry-aware router that estimates each model's chance of success given the request's failure history. It plans retries, escalations and abandonment over failure states and adds live queue waits to the cost, so the same plan becomes load-aware dispatch. translated_title: RetryRoute：面向智能体图像编辑服务的重试感知模型路由
translated_abstract: Web 智能体越来越多地通过在“批判—重试”循环中调用开放编辑模型来完成图像编辑，而这些模型之间的成本相差一个数量级以上。每当编辑结果被拒绝后，服务必须决定是重试同一模型、升级到其他模型，还是放弃。现有的路由器为每个请求只选择一个模型，级联方式则按固定顺序升级，但二者都将重试视为一次独立的尝试。我们识别出一种“粘性失败”现象：在六个开放模型、三个基准测试和两种评判方式下，失败后的重试成功率仅为首次尝试的 17%–53%。基于这一发现，我们提出了 RetryRoute——一种重试感知的路由器，它根据请求的失败历史来估计每个模型的成功概率。它在失败状态之上规划重试、升级和放弃策略，并将实时排队等待时间纳入成本考量，从而使同一计划成为负载感知的调度方式。在主要预算下，RetryRoute 在循环内评判者下的成功率（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文发现图像编辑模型失败后的重试成功率远低于首次尝试（“粘性失败”现象），并据此提出重试感知路由器 RetryRoute，通过结合失败历史、成本与实时队列负载来智能规划重试、升级和放弃策略，显著提升智能体图像编辑服务的成功率。
en_tdlr: Identifying the "sticky failure" phenomenon where image-editing model retries succeed far less often than first attempts, RetryRoute is a retry-aware router that leverages failure history, costs, and live queue loads to plan retries, escalations, and abandonment, significantly improving the success of agentic image editing services.
